header:
Makes part A (1..4) the sound editor's current part (RAM 0x65D) when it is enabled and not already current; L = 1 if it changed, else 0.
Basis: callers + body -- every Se*_OnSideRow2..5 handler passes its row's part (1..4) and sends the page's redraw event only when L = 1.
evidence: audio/semenu_routines.s:6948 `ld wa, 3:i3` / 6949 `call Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper5` -- SePitEnv2_OnSideRow4 passes part 3 (rows 2..5 pass 1..4)
audio/semenu_routines.s:6950 `cp l, 0:i3` / 6952 `ldw wa, 41` / 6954 `call SeMenu_SendEvent` -- caller redraws (event 41) only when L != 0
audio/sound_editor_ui.s:4709 `ld wa, 1:i3` / 4710 `call Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper5` -- same use in SeTonRan1_OnSideRow2 (58 named callers, all OnSideRow2..5)
audio/semenu_routines.s:1754 `lda xwa, (xsp)` / 1755 `calr SeMenu_ValidatePartNumber` -- reads the current part
audio/semenu_routines.s:1757 `cp a, (xsp+2)` -- no change when the requested part is already current
audio/semenu_routines.s:1761 `calr SeMenu_IsPartEnabled` -- refuses a disabled part
audio/semenu_routines.s:1770 `calr SeMenu_SetupMenuDisplay_Finalize_Data` / 1771 `ld l, 1:opc` -- stores the part, returns 1
audio/semenu_routines.s:1033 `ld (1629:16), a` -- SeMenu_SetupMenuDisplay_Finalize_Data writes the current part 0x65D (1..4, else 1), the byte SeMenu_ValidatePartNumber reads
review_note: both batches proposed SeMenu_SelectPart for different routines; the reviewer renamed this one SeMenu_SelectPartIfEnabled (returns L = changed, caller redraws)

header:
Writes the signed value step for a column switch to (XBC) (edit-descriptor byte +10): +1 when A's bits 0-6 are 0 (first bank), -1 otherwise, tripled when A bit 7 is set (switches 17..24).
Basis: callers + body -- the OnColumn handlers fill the descriptor's mask/shift/max/min (+6..+9) and pass their bank byte A from SeTitle_DecodeSwitch.
evidence: display/scoop_editor_data.s:448 `ld (xbc+6), 255` .. 451 `ld (xbc+9), 206` -- SeAmpAmp2_OnColumn3 fills descriptor bytes +6..+9
display/scoop_editor_data.s:452 `ld a, (xsp+16)` / 454 `lda xbc, (xbc+10)` / 455 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper5` -- A = handler argument, XBC = descriptor +10
audio/semenu_routines.s:2173-2180 SeTitle_DecodeSwitch header -- handlers get WA = bank byte: 1 for the second bank, bit 7 set for switches 17..24
audio/semenu_routines.s:2359 `ld l, a` / 2360 `res 7, l` / 2361 `ld e, 255:opc` / 2364 `ld e, 1:opc` -- step -1, or +1 when bits 0-6 are 0
audio/semenu_routines.s:2366 `ld (xbc), e` / 2367 `bit 7, a` / 2370 `muls a, 3` -- step stored, x3 when bit 7 set
audio/semenu_routines.s:1220 `cp (xwa+10), 0` / 1248 `ld a, (xwa+10)` -- SeMenu_TransferPartValues_EndData_Helper reads +10 as the (non-zero) step it applies

header:
Draws bound ScreenData record number A of the pointer table at XIY: XIY = table[A], then SeGfx_DrawBoundRecord.
Basis: callers + body -- all 25 call sites load XIY with a SeScreenData_* pointer table (and A with an index) right before the call.
evidence: audio/sound_editor_ui.s:8774 `ld a, 0:opc` / 8775 `ld xiy, SeScreenData_0x5525` / 8776 `call SeMenu_WaveformSelect_Apply_Helper5` -- index 0 of a pointer table
audio/sound_editor_ui.s:9881 `ld xiy, SeScreenData_0x24B8` / 9882 `call SeMenu_WaveformSelect_Apply_Helper5` -- SeMenu_DataBlock_02
audio/sound_editor_ui.s:13532 `SeScreenData_0x24B8:` / 13533 `.long SeScreenData_0x249A` -- the XIY argument is a table of record pointers
audio/sound_editor_ui.s:10507 `extz xwa` / 10509 `sla wa, 2` / 10510 `add xiy, xwa` / 10511 `ld xiy, (xiy)` -- XIY = table[A]
audio/sound_editor_ui.s:10512 `call SeGfx_DrawBoundRecord` -- renders that record (SeGfx_DrawBoundRecord -> GraphicsRender_Start, line 7772)
note: lines 10514-10528 after its `ret` are an unreached push/pop block, not part of this routine

header:
Applies the 4-byte event at XWA with its byte 3 temporarily set to C: SndParam_ResolveWidget looks it up; if SndParam_DecodeMidiAddr decodes the result, SndPart_SetParam, else SendEpilogue_Data; byte 3 is restored.
Basis: callers + body -- the UIState_ProcessKeyEvent cases copy the SwbtWr event to the stack and call this once per masked field of byte 3.
evidence: audio/note_voice_mapping.s:17156 `ld (xsp+0:8), (SWBTWR_EVENT_TYPE)` .. 17159 `ld (xsp+0x3), (SWBTWR_PAYLOAD_3)` -- parent copies the 4-byte event
audio/note_voice_mapping.s:17180 `lda xwa, (xsp)` / 17183 `and a, 255` / 17187 `calr UIState_ProcessKeyEvent_Helper` -- case 0 passes XWA = event, C = byte 3
audio/note_voice_mapping.s:17251 `and a, 64` / 17255 `calr UIState_ProcessKeyEvent_Helper` -- other cases pass a masked field of byte 3 (&7, &8, &64, &0x7f, 127)
audio/note_voice_mapping.s:18051 `ld a, (xiz+3)` / 18052 `ld (xsp+4), a` / 18053 `ld (xiz+3), c` -- byte 3 saved and replaced by C
audio/note_voice_mapping.s:18059 `call SndParam_ResolveWidget` -- hash lookup of the event (sndparam_routines.s:321)
audio/note_voice_mapping.s:18069 `call SndParam_DecodeMidiAddr` / 18075 `calr SndPart_SetParam` -- part parameter set (SndPart_SetParam header 18089-18093: WA part, BC code, DE value)
audio/note_voice_mapping.s:18080 `calr SendEpilogue_Data` -- fallback when the address is not a part parameter
audio/note_voice_mapping.s:18082 `ld a, (xsp+4)` / 18083 `ld (xiz+3), a` -- byte 3 restored
caveat: the parent's own name/header ("process key event") is generic; the name describes this routine's mechanism only

header:
Clears the box (48,73)-(254,121) and draws the part's keyboard graph: key params A (and A+1, A+2 unless C = 1) placed on x by SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper10 (note 20..108 -> keyboard x), slope from the signed depth in part param 10.
Basis: callers + body -- SeAmpAmp2/SeAmpEnv2/SeFilFil2/SePitEnv2 column handlers call it right after storing the edited value into param 10; the x axis is a 12-key octave table.
evidence: display/scoop_editor_data.s:471 `ldw wa, 10` / 472 `call SeMenu_StorePartParam` / 475 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper11` -- SeAmpAmp2_OnColumn3 copies the edited param 3 into param 10 and redraws (A = 0, C = 0)
audio/semenu_routines.s:3252 `ld wa, 2:i3` / 3253 `ld bc, 1:i3` / 3254 `calr SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper11` -- single-key mode (C = 1) from the pitch-envelope path

audio/semenu_routines.s:4588 `pushw 121` .. 4591 `pushw 48` / 4592 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_AltStore_Helper3` -- clears the graph box (AltStore_Helper3 -> SeGfx_StaticOp1B_FromBuf -> ColorBlit_ByteData)
audio/semenu_routines.s:4596 `calr SeMenu_LoadPartParam` (WA = 10) -- depth (signed, `exts wa` at the slope path)

audio/semenu_routines.s:4575 `lda xde, (GUI_DisplayStructData_0x1110:24)` / 4577 `mul l, 28` -- Helper10: x = 28*octave + table[note%12]; table bytes 0,2,4,6,8,12,14,16,18,20,22,24 = key positions in a 7-white-key octave
audio/semenu_routines.s:4675 `pushw 97` .. 4679 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_AltStore_Helper` -- flat baseline y = 97 across x 48..254 when depth = 0 (AltStore_Helper -> SeGfx_StaticOp00_Line)
caveat: 'key scale' is inferred from the graph's axes (keyboard x, signed depth slope); the title strings were not cross-checked

header:
LFO pages: cycles part C's (1..4) LFO byte (page param C+4) off -> on (bit 5, bits 6-7 = the kind's current number - 1) -> on + bit 4 -> off, then redraws and stores it; WA = 0 amp, 1 pitch, 2 filter.
Basis: callers + body -- only SeAmpLfo1/SePitLfo1/SeFilLfo1 OnSideRow2..5 call it, with WA = page kind and C = row's part.
evidence: display/scoop_editor_data.s:1727 `ld wa, 0:i3` / 1728 `ld bc, 2:i3` / 1729 `call Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper6` -- SeAmpLfo1_OnSideRow3: kind 0, part 2
audio/semenu_routines.s:7030 `ld wa, 1:i3` / 7032 `call Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper6` -- SePitLfo1_OnSideRow3: kind 1
display/scoop_editor_data.s:3827 `ld wa, 2:i3` / 3829 `call Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper6` -- SeFilLfo1_OnSideRow3: kind 2
audio/semenu_routines.s:1781 `calr SeMenu_IsPartEnabled` -- nothing for a disabled part
audio/semenu_routines.s:1785 `inc 4, a` / 1789 `calr SeMenu_LoadPartParam` -- param index = part + 4
audio/semenu_routines.s:1792 `bit 5, a` / 1794 `set 5, a` / 1799 `calr SeMenu_TransferPartValues_EndData` / 1806 `sll a, 6` -- off -> on with bits 6-7 = current number (0x68D/0x68E/0x68F, 1..4) - 1
audio/semenu_routines.s:1811 `bit 4, a` / 1813 `and a, 15` / 1816 `set 4, a` -- on -> on+bit4 -> off
audio/semenu_routines.s:1830 `calr SeMenu_RegisterElement_Extended` / 1835 `calr SeMenu_StorePartParam` -- redraw, store
caveat: what bit 4 selects is not established; 'state' is deliberately neutral

header:
Clears the box (51,59)-(256,144) and draws the amplitude-envelope graph from the current part's params 0..6 (each clamped to 0..100) as connected line segments.
Basis: callers + body -- called only by SeAmpEnv1 column handlers after each edit and by the page refresh after its popup 45.
evidence: display/scoop_editor_data.s:1071 `ldw wa, 45` / 1073 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper2` / 1074 `call Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper8` -- SeAmpEnv1_OnColumn7 edits a value, then redraws
display/scoop_editor_data.s:723 `call Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper8` -- same in SeAmpEnv1_OnColumn1 (676-728); all 8 scoop_editor_data.s callers are SeAmpEnv1_OnColumn1..7
audio/sound_editor_ui.s:1231 `call Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper8` -- after `pushw 45` / `call SeMenu_ShowPopupDialog` (Amp Env1 popup id 45)
audio/semenu_routines.s:3607 `pushw 144` .. 3610 `pushw 51` / 3611 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_AltStore_Helper3` -- clears the graph box
audio/semenu_routines.s:3659 `cp l, 100` / 3661 `ld (xwa), 100` -- envelope values clamped to 100
audio/semenu_routines.s:3851 `calr SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper6` .. 3903 -- segment draws; Helper6 -> Helper9 -> 4545 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_AltStore_Helper` (line)

header:
Clears and draws the filter response graph of the current part: corner x = 86 + part param 2 (cutoff), peak height from part param 3 (resonance, 0..5); A = 0 low-pass / 1 high-pass shape, C = 0 (Lpq/Hpq pages) or 1 (L24/H24 pages, doubled slope, lower box).
Basis: callers + body -- the four filter pages call it with (A,C) = (0,0) Lpq1, (1,0) Hpq1, (0,1) L241, (1,1) H241 after editing cutoff/resonance.
evidence: display/scoop_editor_data.s:1969 `ld wa, 0:i3` / 1970 `ld bc, 0:i3` / 1971 `jp UpdSeSel_DetailedUpdate_SetDisplayState_Helper4` -- SeFilLpq1_OnColumn1
display/scoop_editor_data.s:2489 / 2605 / 2772 -- SeFilHpq1 (1,0), SeFilL241 (0,1), SeFilH241 (1,1) do the same
audio/sound_editor_ui.s:1596 `call UpdSeSel_DetailedUpdate_SetDisplayState_Helper4` -- page refresh after popup 48
audio/semenu_routines.s:4999 `ld wa, 2:i3` / 5000 `calr SeMenu_LoadPartParam` / 5001 `resm 7, (xsp+14)` -- param 2
audio/semenu_routines.s:5003 `ld wa, 3:i3` / 5005 `andmi8 (xsp+12), 7` / 5008 `ld (xsp+12), 5` -- param 3 clamped to 5
audio/semenu_routines.s:5018 `add wa, 86` / 5019 `ld qiz, wa` -- corner x from param 2
audio/semenu_routines.s:5023 `mul c, 3` vs 5031 `mul c, 6` -- peak height x3 (C = 0) or x6 (C = 1)

audio/semenu_routines.s:5043 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_AltStore_Helper3` / 5053 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_AltStore_Helper` -- box clear, then line segments (A = 0 path starts at x 67 = flat pass band)

header:
Runs the foot-pedal function assigned by code BC: index = PanelAction_PedalAssignHandlerIndex[BC]; if <= 22, calls PanelAction_PedalFunctionHandlers[index] with XWA = the panel event.
Basis: callers + body -- PanelAction_FootSwitch1/2 and FootController1-4 pass their assignment parameter (0x2886..0x2890) in BC.
evidence: audio/audio_control_engine.s:1118 `; foot switch FS1 (PG.2; event 28 bit 0): acts per panel parameter 0x2886` -- caller header
audio/audio_control_engine.s:1124 `ld xwa, 10374` / 1125 `call SndParam_LookupReadOnly` / 1128 `ld bc, hl` / 1129 `calr FileIO_BytecodeData_Code_Helper4` -- BC = pedal assignment
audio/audio_control_engine.s:1312 `lda xde, (PanelAction_PedalAssignHandlerIndex:24)` / 1313 `ld e, (xde+bc)` / 1314 `cp e, 22` / 1315 `ret ugt`
audio/audio_control_engine.s:1318 `lda xhl, (PanelAction_PedalFunctionHandlers:24)` / 1322 `call (xhl)` -- calls the handler
ui_widgets/extension_device_screens.s:1029-1039 -- table headers already describe this routine; lines 1030 and 1035 quote the old name and must be updated with the rename

why_refused: Body is mechanically clear but its domain is not: it advances the current stream's (index RAM 0x0EEE) read offset (table 0x0CBE) by DE bytes, crossing 256-byte blocks that carry 251 data bytes (offsets 5..255; `ldw bc, 251` / `div xwa, bc`). Every caller (Timer_ModeHandler_0_Helper4, MemConfig_Handler_5_Helper4, PerfMode_EventTable_0_Target1_Helper4/7, VoiceSlot_ReadParamsWithSaveRestore, VoiceParam_BitManipHelper) sits in the mislabelled scoop_display.s player block and only shows 'save state, advance N, read current byte' -- nothing says what the stream is (song/track data is a guess).
evidence: display/scoop_display.s:3045 `ld de, 3:i3` / 3046 `call VoiceSlot_ReadParamsWithSaveRestore_Helper2` -- caller passes a byte count
display/scoop_display.s:3559 `ld de, 4:i3` / 3560 call / 3561 `call VoiceSlot_ReadCurrentParams` -- advance then read
display/scoop_display.s:10289 `add e, (xix+32)` / 10292 `cp de, 255` -- offset + DE past the block end?
display/scoop_display.s:10317 `ldw bc, 251` / 10319 `div xwa, bc` -- blocks of 251 data bytes
display/scoop_display.s:10301 `ld (xwa+hl), e` (XWA = 3262) -- new offset stored

why_refused: Body is only a fixed set of display refreshes: Display_UpdateRegion0, 1, 6, 3, MemConfig_Handler_3_Helper6, Display_UpdateRegion2 (each region routine redraws if dirty, or marks dirty when updates are disabled). All 11 callers are placeholder-named handlers in the same scoop_display.s block (MemConfig_Handler_*, SysEx_BytecodeDispatcher, PortConfig_Handler_0, VoiceState_DataBlock2) and do not say which screen or state this partial refresh belongs to; the region meanings in Display_UpdateDirtyRegions' comments are themselves unverified. A name would be body-only.
evidence: display/scoop_display.s:8770 `call Display_UpdateRegion0` .. 8775 `call Display_UpdateRegion2` -- whole body
display/scoop_display.s:3505 `call MemConfig_Handler_5_Helper11` -- after Helper12 / DMA_FlagCheckWithCalls, then `ld w, 98` / `call MIDI_SendSysExFromW`
display/scoop_display.s:7834 `call MemConfig_Handler_5_Helper11` -- SysEx_BytecodeDispatcher_Skip
display/scoop_display.s:76-80 Display_UpdateRegion0 -- sets the dirty bit when DISPLAY_ENABLE_FLAG bit 0 is clear

why_refused: Callers are entries 2,3,4,6,7 (and 10..) of OscScope_HandlerTable, dispatched by PerfMode_ParamHandler_11 on an unexplained index; they give no meaning. Body: clears bit 5 and sets bit 6 of byte 0 of the 4-byte record (*(0x1114))[(0x0EC4)] -- the record type is unknown.
evidence: display/scoop_display.s:13484 `call OscScope_Handler_2_Helper` -- OscScope_Handler_2 (likewise _3, _4, _6, _7)
display/scoop_display.s:13453 `ld xde, OscScope_HandlerTable` / 13456 `call (xhl)` -- dispatcher in PerfMode_ParamHandler_11
display/scoop_display.s:13499 `ld xix, (4372:16)` / 13500 `ld e, (3780:16)` / 13501 `sla e, 2` -- 4-byte record indexed by 0x0EC4
display/scoop_display.s:13505 `andmi8 (xix), 223` / 13506 `ormi8 (xix), 64` -- bit 5 off, bit 6 on

header:
Steps the current part's filter resonance (part param 3, range 0..5) by the column switch in A and applies it via SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper2 (popup id E), then posts the column's dial events (SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper4(C)).
Basis: callers + body -- filter-page column handlers (Lpq1/Hpq1 col 2, L241/H241 col 4, Bpf1 col 3) call it, then redraw with SeMenu_DrawFilterGraph, which plots param 3 as the peak height.
evidence: display/scoop_editor_data.s:2025 `ld bc, 2:i3` / 2026 `ldw de, 48` / 2027 `calr Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper2` / 2030 `jp UpdSeSel_DetailedUpdate_SetDisplayState_Helper4` -- SeFilLpq1_OnColumn2
display/scoop_editor_data.s:2928 `ld bc, 3:i3` / 2930 `calr Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper2` -- SeFilBpf1_OnColumn3
display/scoop_editor_data.s:2041 `ld wa, 3:i3` / 2042 `call SeMenu_LoadPartParam` -- param 3
display/scoop_editor_data.s:2044 `ld (xbc+6), 127` .. 2046 `ld (xbc+8), 5` / 2047 `ld (xbc+9), 0` -- range 0..5
display/scoop_editor_data.s:2075 `ld bc, 3:i3` / then `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper2` -- applied to param 3
audio/semenu_routines.s:5005-5008, 5023/5031 -- SeMenu_DrawFilterGraph draws param 3 (<= 5) as the resonance peak height

why_refused: Callers are SndDispatch_Handler_1..4 / SndDispatch_TableEntryBegin, table entries with no established meaning. Body clears 0x0DFC/0x0DFD/0x0D6A, masks 0x0D53, then loops reading the current stream byte (VoiceSlot_ReadCurrentParams) and dispatching on codes 0x81/0x82/0x90 (VoiceSlot_DispatchRet / VoiceSlot_LoadAndDispatch); what those codes are (event markers of a song format?) is not established in the source.
evidence: display/scoop_display.s:8381 `call SndDispatch_Handler_1_Helper2` -- SndDispatch_Handler_1, a table entry
display/scoop_display.s:8640 `call VoiceSlot_FlagCheck` / 8641 `cp a, 130`
display/scoop_display.s:8643 `call VoiceSlot_ReadCurrentParams` / 8645 `cp a, 129` / 8647 `incw 1, (3416:16)`
display/scoop_display.s:8653 `call VoiceSlot_DispatchRet` / 8656 `call VoiceSlot_LoadAndDispatch`

header:
Sets the graphics background colour word (RAM 0x3EFA2) to WA; text and mono-bitmap drawing use it for 0 bits (0xF5 = copy the wallpaper pixel).
Basis: callers + body -- the four screen-init sequences call it with WA = 0xF5 next to GraphicsRender_ByteData (foreground colour, 0x3EFA4 = 0xFF).
evidence: ui/ui_playback_modes.s:3469 `ldw wa, 0x00ff` / 3470 `call GraphicsRender_ByteData` / 3471 `ldw wa, 0x00f5` / 3472 `call DirmdEmulator_Dispatch_Code_Helper` -- Display_InitGraphicsAndScreen
audio/presentation_sound_nav.s:1305 `call DirmdEmulator_Dispatch_Code_Helper` -- DirmdEmu_CaseF (same sequence; also DirmdEmu_OnAllPaint, CmpStep_DataBlock)
display/graphics_text_vga.s:89 `ld (0x03efa2:24), wa` -- the whole body
ui/ui_window_procs.s:8286 `; The background colour (bit 0) is the word at 0x03efa2` / 8459 `ld iz, (0x03efa2:24)` -- DrawMonoBitmap reads it as background
display/graphics_text_vga.s:378 `pushw (0x3efa4:24)` / 379 `pushw (0x3efa2:24)` -- text draws pass fg and bg colours

header:
Loads palette slots 32..63 (GraphicsRender_LowBandColorIndex) and 192..223 (GraphicsRender_PaletteSrc192) from the RGB table and flags a palette update; queued on the draw ring when not called from the draw task.
Basis: callers + body -- the screen-init sequences call it between setting fg/bg colours and loading slots 64..191 from a selectable table (DirmdEmulator_Dispatch_Code_Helper2).
evidence: ui/ui_playback_modes.s:3473 `call DirmdEmulator_Dispatch_Code_Helper3` / 3474 `ldw wa, 0x00ff` / 3475 `call DirmdEmulator_Dispatch_Code_Helper2` -- Display_InitGraphicsAndScreen
audio/presentation_sound_nav.s:1306 `call DirmdEmulator_Dispatch_Code_Helper3` -- DirmdEmu_CaseF (also DirmdEmu_OnAllPaint, CmpStep_DataBlock)
display/graphics_text_vga.s:138 `calr IS_XSP_INSIDE_4K_REGION_AT_1C032` / 142 `calr DrawQueue_Alloc` / 146 `jrl DrawRing_Post` -- deferred when not on the draw task
display/graphics_text_vga.s:151 `ldw iz, 32` / 156 `ld xbc, GraphicsRender_LowBandColorIndex` / 163 `call SetPaletteRGB` / 165 `cp iz, 64` -- slots 32..63
display/graphics_text_vga.s:167 `ldw iz, 192` / 172 `ld xbc, GraphicsRender_PaletteSrc192` / 181 `cp iz, 224` -- slots 192..223
display/graphics_text_vga.s:184 `ldw (PALETTE_UPDATE_FLAG:24), 1` -- update flagged
display/graphics_text_vga.s:121 `ld (0x03efa6:24), wa` / 124 `ldw iz, 64` / 130 `cp iz, 192` -- by contrast Helper2 fills 64..191 from table index WA, so these two bands are the fixed ones

header:
If byte 0 of the panel event at XWA is 0 and byte 1 is not 3, writes the selected part (PART_SELECT, 0x8D3A) into byte 0.
Basis: callers + body -- PanelAction_PostUnlessDemo and the other panel actions call it on the event frame immediately before PanelEvent_Post.
evidence: audio/audio_control_engine.s:68 `; unless MD_DEMO: FileIO_BytecodeData_Code_Helper2 on the frame, then post both events` -- caller header (quotes the old name)
audio/audio_control_engine.s:74 `ld xwa, xiz` / 75 `calr FileIO_BytecodeData_Code_Helper2` / 77 `calr PanelEvent_Post` -- PanelAction_PostUnlessDemo
audio/audio_control_engine.s:1273 `.byte 0x80, 0x3f, 0x00` / 1274 `ret nz` -- unidasm v10 0xFC6350: cp (XWA),0x00
audio/audio_control_engine.s:1275 `.byte 0x88, 0x01, 0x3f, 0x03` / 1276 `ret z` -- cp (XWA+0x01),0x03
audio/audio_control_engine.s:1277 `.byte 0xb0, 0x14, 0x3a, 0x8d` -- ld (XWA),(0x8d3a); shared/ram_variables.s:128 `.equ PART_SELECT, 0x8d3a`
note: the body is still spelled as .byte; native spelling is `cp (xwa), 0` / `cp (xwa+1), 3` / `ld (xwa), (PART_SELECT)`

why_refused: Callers are the same placeholder-named scoop_display.s handlers as MemConfig_Handler_5_Helper11 (it is always called just before it). Body: if (0x28BE) = 0xFF, Display_UpdateRegion1; otherwise tests bit 7 of (0xF250)[3*((0x0D60)-1)] and runs SubCPU_ToneParamRet_Helper13/Helper/VoiceBank_ProcessCommand and several 0x0EB5-coded branches. Too many unexplained state bytes to pin a meaning.
evidence: display/scoop_display.s:3503 `call MemConfig_Handler_5_Helper12` -- followed by DMA_FlagCheckWithCalls and MemConfig_Handler_5_Helper11
display/scoop_display.s:12922 `cp (0x28be:16), 255` / 12925 `call Display_UpdateRegion1`
display/scoop_display.s:12935 `ld xde, 0xf250` / 12936 `bit 7, (xde+hl)`
display/scoop_display.s:12939 `call SubCPU_ToneParamRet_Helper13` / 12942 `call VoiceBank_ProcessCommand` / 12943 `cp (0x0eb5:16), 129`

header:
Steps the current part's filter cutoff (part param 2, range 0..127) by the column switch in A and applies it via SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper2 (popup id E), then posts the column's dial events (SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper4(C)).
Basis: callers + body -- filter-page column handlers (Lpq1/Hpq1 col 1, L241/H241 col 3) call it, then redraw with SeMenu_DrawFilterGraph, which places the corner at x = 86 + param 2.
evidence: display/scoop_editor_data.s:1966 `ld bc, 1:i3` / 1967 `ldw de, 48` / 1968 `calr Scoop_SoundEditorData_Helper` / 1971 `jp UpdSeSel_DetailedUpdate_SetDisplayState_Helper4` -- SeFilLpq1_OnColumn1
display/scoop_editor_data.s:1982 `ld wa, 2:i3` / 1983 `call SeMenu_LoadPartParam` -- param 2
display/scoop_editor_data.s:1987 `ld (xbc+8), 127` / 1988 `ld (xbc+9), 0` -- range 0..127
display/scoop_editor_data.s:1992 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper5` / 2016 `ld bc, 2:i3` / 2017 `call SeMenu_ApplyPartEdit_Helper2` -- step, apply to param 2
